chunks: The unbelievers must not think that the respite We give them augurs well. We do so that they sink deeper into sin, and suffer an ignominious doom.

key_terms.لِيَزْدَادُوا إِثْمًا: That they may increase in sin

ai.seo_question: Why does God delay punishment for disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *al-Tamhīl* (divine reprieve), where God grants sinners time not out of mercy, but to accumulate greater guilt and ensure a more severe reckoning. It serves as a warning against mistaking worldly stability for divine approval, emphasizing that the delay in punishment is a strategic increase in sin (*li-yazdādū ithman*) before the ultimate humiliating chastisement.
